_schema.description: Board-wide invalidation/annotation registry (board-integrity pass 2026-08-04). One committed, machine-readable place where superseded, flattered, or absent-not-failed numbers are FLAGGED so prior bakes/evals never sit on stolen wins. Consumers: `freeze_check --annotations` (default = this file; floor rows print '— (absent)' for absent-not-failed axes, TSV gains n_measured/absent/annotations columns) and `scripts/v_next/gauntlet.py` (warning badge + tooltip reason on affected cells/fields + caption line). Entries are append-only; never delete — supersede with a new entry and point `fix_path` at the resolution.

entry_fields.id: stable kebab-case identifier, referenced from docs and tooltips
entry_fields.kind: one of: 'invalidated' (the number is wrong/superseded — do not cite), 'annotated' (the number is real but must be read with the stated caveat), 'absent-not-failed' (the field is missing because the instrument did not exist / was not run for this cell; absence is 'not measured', DISTINCT from a measured fail — consumers print '— (absent)' and state both n/8 (registered absent=not-passed rule) and n/m-measured forms)
entry_fields.fields: list of fulleval dot-paths the entry covers; a path covers itself and any deeper subpath (segment-boundary prefix match), e.g. 'rank.hfnlproxy' covers 'rank.hfnlproxy.per_ref_mean'
entry_fields.scope: predicate object selecting which fulleval cells the entry applies to; exactly one key of: {"missing": "dot.path"} (field absent or null), {"present": "dot.path"} (field present and non-null), {"names": ["bake", ...]} (exact bake-name list), {"all": true} (every cell)
entry_fields.reason: one-sentence human reason shown in tooltips/reports
entry_fields.evidence: commit sha(s) / doc section that established the finding
entry_fields.fix_path: what un-flags a cell (re-measure path, tooling, or 'none — permanent caveat')

entries.reason: INVALIDATED: the PRE-FIX m3a_coherence published for these 32 944-input cells. Before 299ccc8c (2026-08-04), compute_attribution_density_full sliced the model gradient as s[720..min(len,924)], so the append2/BANDVIS block (f924-943) never reached the attribution density -- 8 of its 20 slots (BANDVIS_GAIN/LOSS x 4 scales) are class-E mean pools and were REAL dropped coverage (the other 12 are correctly zero: reference-only, or HDR-gated on a structurally-SDR route). Every pre-fix 944 M3a is therefore too LOW. All three registered materiality thresholds fired. The value now on the board for each of these cells is the CORRECTED re-measurement with a binary at 299ccc8c, same 27 fixtures, same bake bytes (sha256-verified against the recorded bake_sha256). Do NOT compare these cells against any 944 M3a table dated before 2026-08-04, and do not cite a pre-fix number. M3 is unaffected (the legacy signal fold is untouched); 372/720/924-width bakes are unaffected by construction and are not in this entry's scope.

entries.reason: the ext-lineage eval tables (ext720/ext924/ext944 ext_kadid.parquet) store human_score = (5-dmos)/4, the INVERSE of the canonical (dmos-1)/4 — KADID's dmos is quality-oriented (raw crowdsourced DCR falls 4.0789->2.0072 across severity levels 1-5, 349,800 ratings). Every KADID stat measured on an ext root has the WRONG SIGN vs KADID's real human MOS: negate srocc_signed to read it. Rank-order stats (srocc/krocc/pwrc) negate exactly; PLCC/Z-RMSE/OR/bands were fit against a reflected target and must be re-measured, not negated. 110 of 188 board bakes are anti-correlated with KADID's true MOS while the board renders all 188 as positive magnitudes. SCOPE NARROWED 2026-08-05: the ext roots were rebuilt with the corrected target (appendix H part 1), so this entry's blanket scope was replaced by the exact list of the 188 verdicts that existed at rebuild time — every one of them measured KADID on the inverted table. Verdicts produced after the rebuild measure it correctly and are covered by kadid-ext-root-corrected-2026-08-05. Nothing about the finding changed; only the predicate became precise, because leaving it at `all` would have rendered a FALSE 'inverted' badge on correctly-measured cells.
